The average number of views per song for S1, S2 and S3 is 100. The average number of views per song for S4, S5 and S6 is 50. What is the total number of views for all the songs sung by all of the 6 different singers taken together?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values/ No. of values

**Calculation:**

As, average number of views per song for S1, S2 and S3 = 100

Here, no. of songs of S1 = 20

⇒ Average = Sum of values/ No. of songs

⇒ 100 = Sum / 20⇔ Sum of S1= 100× 20 = 2000

Now, no. of songs of S2 = 25

⇒ Average = Sum of S2/25

⇒ 100 = Sum of S2/25 ⇔ Sum of S2 = 100×
